// Generated by tools/build_definition_tables.py; edit the referenced modules.

// @include "keyconf/KEYCONF.abilities"
// Network events are synchronized and cannot spoof another player's activation.
alias utnt_offense "netevent utnt_ability 1"
alias utnt_defense "netevent utnt_ability 2"
addkeysection "$UTNT_OPTIONS_TITLE" UTNTAbilities
addmenukey "$UTNT_AB_OFFENSE" utnt_offense
addmenukey "$UTNT_AB_DEFENSE" utnt_defense
defaultbind q utnt_offense
defaultbind g utnt_defense

// @include "keyconf/KEYCONF.objectives"
// Local hold/release commands; no network event or gameplay button is consumed.
alias +utnt_objectives "event utnt_objectives 1"
alias -utnt_objectives "event utnt_objectives 0"
addkeysection "$UTNT_OPTIONS_TITLE" UTNTObjectives
addmenukey "$UTNT_OBJ_KEY" +utnt_objectives
defaultbind o +utnt_objectives

// @include "keyconf/KEYCONF.thunder"
// Optional console helpers; no keys are rebound.
alias utnt_thunder_far "netevent utnt_thunder_test 0 1 0"
alias utnt_thunder_mid "netevent utnt_thunder_test 1 1 0"
alias utnt_thunder_near "netevent utnt_thunder_test 2 1 0"
alias utnt_thunder_off "netevent utnt_thunder_control 0"
alias utnt_thunder_auto "netevent utnt_thunder_control 1"
alias utnt_thunder_status "netevent utnt_thunder_control 2"
